FISHING LICENCE · INDIA

India fishing licence

Visitors must check the permit for each state and water. Himachal Pradesh and Jammu and Kashmir issue local angling licences; neither licence provides nationwide cover.

Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-11

Who needs one

  • Anglers in Himachal Pradesh's regulated trout and general waters.
  • Trout anglers in Jammu and Kashmir.

Licence options and prices

LicenceForLengthPrice
Jammu and Kashmir foreign angler trout permitnon resident1 dayINR 3500

Rules visitors should know

  • Use the permit for its approved water.
  • In Himachal Pradesh trout waters, the licence rules prohibit trout fishing from November through February.

How to buy

Use the relevant state Fisheries Department. Jammu and Kashmir advertises online trout permits; Himachal Pradesh lists local licence offices.

Common license questions

Do I need a fishing licence in India?

Visitors must check the permit for each state and water. Himachal Pradesh and Jammu and Kashmir issue local angling licences; neither licence provides nationwide cover.

How much is a visitor fishing licence in India?

Jammu and Kashmir foreign angler trout permit: INR 3500 (checked November 2026).

Where do I buy a fishing licence in India?

Use the relevant state Fisheries Department. Jammu and Kashmir advertises online trout permits; Himachal Pradesh lists local licence offices.
